# Logomakerr.ai

> AI-powered logo maker platform that enables users to create professional logos in minutes with customizable templates, design tools, and branding solutions.

Logomakerr.ai is a free online logo generator that combines artificial intelligence with an extensive template library to help businesses and entrepreneurs design custom logos without requiring design expertise. The platform offers multiple export formats (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF) and tiered pricing plans for professional branding needs.

## Core Tools & Features

- [Free AI Logo Generator](https://logomakerr.ai/generate): Main logo generation tool with AI-powered design customization for creating professional logos in minutes
- [Logo Templates Library](https://logomakerr.ai/logo): Industry-specific logo templates and design ideas with customization options for every business type
- [Homepage](https://logomakerr.ai): Main landing page for Logomakerr.ai AI logo generator and branding tool

## Pricing & Plans

- [Logo Design Pricing](https://logomakerr.ai/pricing): Pricing plans for logo design packages ranging from $29 to $99 with various features and export options

## Resources & Education

- [Blog](https://logomakerr.ai/blog): Blog featuring design tips, branding guides, and business insights for logo creation and brand development
